why: Held back. It clears the usability floor, so nothing mechanical would stop it; this is an editorial decision and that is the point of this file. Its reader cannot produce compound words at all — SudachiDict-small has no compound entries, so Sudachi's longest-unit mode has nothing to join — and Japanese vocabulary is largely compounds. More books will not fix it. The fix is measured and recorded in blinkered-attestation/STATUS.md and needs every Japanese collection read again.
